newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens higher after Wall Street gains.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens higher after Wall Street gains.

text.p: Leading UK blue chips edged higher at the open on Friday -- the first day of trading after the Christmas break -- boosted by solid gains on Wall Street overnight, dealers said.
At 0842 GMT, the FTSE 100 was up 5.5 points to 4,098.0.
Dealers said the index is poised to easily surpass the 4,100 mark, the record intraday high set last Friday following the Dow's 23.83 point advance overnight to 6,546.68.
Most other world stock indices also rose overnight, including the Japanese Nikkei 225 index, which rebounded overnight after having tumbled 1.3 percent on Thursday.
